babel_full.description: the full rebuild, through buildProject: every covered file is re-read, re-parsed and recompiled on every revision. This is the existing compiler semantics and the semantic reference.

babel_incremental.description: the project session: a revision re-scans and re-hashes the covered set, rebuilds the coverage closure from persistent module summaries, and recompiles only the files whose validity key changed. No Spike 1 work-elimination flag is involved.

policy.engine_order_randomisation: per (cell, scenario, cache-state, iteration): the two engines are shuffled with a seed derived from the job identity, so thermal and order bias do not systematically favour one engine

timer.wall_clock_used_for: event ordering metadata only, never a duration

policy.os_cache_state_reason: dropping the OS page cache requires privileges this environment does not grant, and faking it with posix_fadvise would not reproduce a cold cache. Every number here is a WARM-OS-cache number and is labelled so.
